primary.policy: GitHub CI builds are evidence; only an explicitly selected workflow-dispatch run is release artifact authority.

secondary.policy: Reproduction/debug evidence only; never release artifact authority.

build_root.policy: Use BUILD_DIR=/path for Make-level custom build roots; BC250_BUILD_DIR is internal to helper scripts and must not be supplied independently.

evidence.environment_policy: Record Fedora/container and key tool versions; do not pin the entire Fedora toolchain.

advisory_quality.policy: Run repository test modules not already covered by the blocking preflight or package-critical gates for additional post-build visibility. Ruff, ShellCheck, current-guidance/scope checks, package-critical tests and configured rpmlint are blocking elsewhere in make release-gate.

blocking_static.policy: Ruff and ShellCheck run before freeze/build so predictable source defects cannot consume an authoritative GitHub RPM iteration.

rpmlint.policy: Configured rpmlint runs on the built RPMs and blocks artifact evidence on any unfiltered finding; only documented appliance-specific false positives belong in packaging/rpmlint.toml.

stages.description: run blocking Ruff/ShellCheck and current-guidance/scope/release contracts, verify pinned sources, then freeze Source0 and spec
build the source RPM from the exact frozen Source0/spec snapshot without compiling the binary payload

rebuild that frozen SRPM once in an isolated temporary topdir; RPM %check runs the package-critical set, and those exact rebuilt binary RPMs are published to dist for payload validation and blocking rpmlint
emit closed binary/source manifests plus release-evidence.json from the exact SRPM and rebuilt binaries that become GitHub artifacts
